column1: ## Repository Table R5. Local diversity during cohort integration

## Description: Cohort-balanced local SNV haplotype richness across 577 sampled 100 kb windows. Total sampled chromosome copies increase as cohorts are added. Ratio uses the full reference baseline, not the initial selected subset.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Scenario | Scenario for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Windows | Windows for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Mean distinct haplotypes | Mean distinct haplotypes for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Lower 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
## Column 5 | Upper 95% bound | Source-reported percentile interval endpoint unless the table description specifies exact binomial inference.
## Column 6 | Ratio to full UK Biobank reference | Ratio to full UK Biobank reference for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 7 | Novel window–haplotype observations | Novel window–haplotype observations for the observation defined in the table description.

column6: Ratio to full UK Biobank reference
